Data & Account Deletion

How to delete local wallet data on your device or request deletion of an optional market.pc.am / exchange.pc.am web account.

1. PCoin Wallet & Miner apps (Android, Windows, Linux)

The Android PCoin Wallet app (am.pc.pcoinwallet on Google Play), the Android miner APK (am.pc.pcoinminer), and the Windows/Linux node and wallet programs do not create accounts and store zero user data on our servers. Because we hold no record of your wallet, email, identity, or keys, there is no server-side wallet profile for us to delete.

Before clearing app storage or uninstalling: Write down your 12-word or 24-word recovery phrase on paper and verify it. Uninstalling a non-custodial wallet or clearing its storage permanently erases the encrypted keys on that device, and nobody can recover your coins without your phrase.

To erase all local wallet data from your device:

  • Android (PCoin Wallet / PCoin Miner): Open Android Settings → Apps → PCoin Wallet → Storage → Clear data, or uninstall the app.
  • Windows: Uninstall from Windows Settings (or run the uninstaller) and, if you wish to remove the blockchain and wallet directory completely, delete %LOCALAPPDATA%\PCoinWallet and/or %LOCALAPPDATA%\PCoin after moving or backing up your funds.
  • Linux: Stop bitcoind and remove ~/.pcoin after backing up your wallet.

Note: Transactions already confirmed on the public PCoin peer-to-peer blockchain are part of an open cryptographic ledger replicated across independent nodes worldwide and cannot be deleted by anyone.

2. Optional web account deletion (market.pc.am / exchange.pc.am / wrapdesk.pc.am)

market.pc.am, exchange.pc.am, and wrapdesk.pc.am share one optional email-based account. To delete that web account and your login credentials:

  1. Withdraw any remaining spendable PCN or eligible USDT balance and confirm you have no open orders, pending withdrawals, or in-flight wrap requests.
  2. Send an email from the registered account email address to pcoin@pc.am with the subject line Delete market.pc.am account.
  3. Once ownership of the email address is verified, your login credentials, 2FA secret, and personal profile data are permanently deleted within 7 days. Minimal ledger entries tied to completed financial settlements or on-chain payouts may be retained solely as required for accounting integrity and double-spend/fraud prevention.
